topic: verify.json can attest a commit it never tested
lesson: verify.py records head_sha(root) AFTER the phases finish, so any commit landing mid-run is stamped into verify.json as the tested commit. The evidence then attests code that was never executed. Freeze the tree for the whole run, or capture head_sha BEFORE the first phase and refuse if HEAD moved.
source: PH-4 story gates: two verify runs stamped a HEAD created after the run started
